note: Adapted from Chhotani's (1997) species-level description of Synhamitermes colombensis; the original is in English. No alate is recorded, only soldier and worker; the antennae of the soldier examined are broken, so the number of segments is not recorded; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark straw yellow; mandibles dark brown, pale brown at the base; pronotum and body straw yellow. Dorsum of the head hairless; postclypeus hairless or with a pair of setae at the anterior margin; labrum, pronotum and body sparsely setose. Head subquadrate, posterior margin rounded, sides nearly straight (length to the base of the mandibles 0.85–0.95 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.85 mm); Y-shaped suture absent. Antennae of the specimens examined broken. Postclypeus spindle-shaped, well delimited; anteclypeus translucent white, hairless, narrow. Labrum subquadrate, slightly narrowed anteriorly (length 0.13–0.15 mm, maximum width 0.18–0.20 mm). Mandibles short (length 0.65–0.70 mm), from the middle strongly curved inwards towards the apex, outer margin not incurved; left mandible with a large triangular tooth at the middle of the inner margin, right mandible with a large, slightly subquadrate tooth in the corresponding position; mandible length about three quarters of the head length (mandible/head length ratio 0.72–0.76). Postmentum wide, clavate, widest in the anterior third, narrowest near the posterior margin (length 0.50–0.55 mm, maximum width 0.25–0.28 mm, minimum width at the waist 0.20 mm; contraction index, the ratio of minimum to maximum width, 0.73–0.80). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior lobe semicircular with a weak median notch on the anterior margin; posterior margin straight, not notched (length 0.25, width 0.50 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and pronotum straw yellow, tinged with smoky; antennae and labrum pale yellow. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Head subquadrate (length to the base of the mandibles 0.70 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.85 mm). Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 2 and 4 equal in length. Postclypeus raised, setose, length about equal to half the width; anteclypeus subtrapezoidal, hairless, translucent. Labrum subquadrate, setose (length 0.20, width 0.25 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not notched, posterior margin nearly straight and not notched (length 0.25, width 0.50 mm).
